{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Calculate the response rate for treatment and control groups
response_rate_treatment = data[data['treatment'] == 1]['response'].mean()
response_rate_control = data[data['treatment'] == 0]['response'].mean()

# Calculate the treatment effect as the difference in proportions
treatment_effect = response_rate_treatment - response_rate_control
treatment_effect"}
